mapper.select: SELECT slide.image_id AS image_id, slide.can_serve_tiles AS can_serve_tiles, slide.source_url AS source_url, slide.tile_metadata_json AS tile_metadata_json, slide.thumbnail_url AS thumbnail_url, slide.thumbnail_width AS thumbnail_width, slide.thumbnail_height AS thumbnail_height, slide.thumbnail_content_type AS thumbnail_content_type FROM wsi_slide slide PREWHERE slide.cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND slide.release_id = #{releaseId} AND slide.image_id = #{imageId} LIMIT 1
